code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    colors=set(v for row in grid for v in row)-{0,4}
    for color in colors:
        pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
        if not pts: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if grid[r0][c]==0: out[r0][c]=color
            if grid[r1][c]==0: out[r1][c]=color
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            if grid[r][c0]==0: out[r][c0]=color
            if grid[r][c1]==0: out[r][c1]=color
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
